goal: Make the equipment simulator save and explicitly import complete gear configurations, while projecting the existing 80 Talent winner source characters into two legal, real-player community gear templates per class and specialization.
userValue: A player can save the current equipment and enhancements, deliberately choose a saved or community source template, and clear the workbench. Community gear remains attributable to the matching Talent winner and never silently substitutes a baseline or unrelated player.
nonGoals: Do not change the Talent winner elected for any class, specialization or Hero tree.
Do not collect a separate community gear ranking, expose a baseline/recommendation as community gear, or perform read-time synchronization.
Do not merge before candidate data/runtime evidence and explicit WeChat acceptance.

mustChange: Persist the Talent election's full ordered Raider.IO candidate sequence on each elected Talent row.
Keep observed gear by stable player identity and project one legal gear winner per Hero slot without a second ranking.
Publish/import exactly the two sealed Hero-slot rows and preserve explicit save/import/reset actions in the active Taro equipment route.
mustNotChange: Talent winner ranking and identity remain immutable when gear fallback occurs.
The canonical backend resolver remains the only community-import legality authority.
The user-owned apps/mini-taro/project.config.json is not part of this task.
riskUnknown: The current production Talent winner rows may predate gearProjectionCandidates and need one authorized existing-source sync before a v2 Community Release can be staged.
A Hero slot may remain pending_collection if every existing same-Hero candidate lacks legal captured equipment.
evidenceRequired: Exact candidate code/build identity, health/API/PG/timer smoke and rollback target.
A controlled existing-source community-template sync and a v2 candidate release showing no public baseline and honest pending slots.
Real WeChat acceptance of save, saved import, two Hero-labelled community choices when available, and full reset.

ownership.factOwner: Talent promotion owns source order; the canonical gear resolver owns legality; Gear Release owns sealed public projection; Taro only renders and requests exact imports.

engineeringHealth.reason: This changes PostgreSQL-backed source persistence, Community Release projection and an active user route; pure projection tests, candidate isolation, source-sync evidence and rollback are required.

acceptanceEvidence: Strict Harness full profile at a clean exact task head.
Candidate API and release smoke, including exact-ID import and no-baseline proof.
Controlled production community-template refresh using only the established sources and a rollback-ready candidate release.
Explicit real WeChat acceptance of every frozen manual item.

decisionLog.decision: The user confirmed that the Talent simulator's 80 winner source characters are the equipment projection source; each class/spec surfaces the two matching Hero-tree winners.
If a Talent winner has illegal or incomplete equipment, only gear projection continues in the same class/spec/hero/scenario candidate order; the Talent winner never changes.
The user authorized candidate verification and the controlled existing-source data refresh required to prepare manual testing.
